item.title: Bandits Drowning In Sokoto River Is Fake – NIWA
item.description: The National Inland Waterways Authority, NIWA, has dismissed reports alleging that about 150 bandits drowned in a boat mishap in the Sabon Gida area of Sabon Birni Local Government Area of Sokoto State.

item.title: Nasarawa LP Chairman Dismisses Suspension Rumours
item.description: The Nasarawa State Chairman of the Labour Party, Alexander Ombugu, has dismissed speculations that he has been suspended from the party by a group of persons parading themselves as caretaker committee members in the state.

item.title: Soludo Appoints 39-Year-old As Anambra’s First Female SSG
item.description: The governor of Anambra state, Chukwuma Soludo, has approved the appointment of Chiamaka Nnake as the new Secretary to the State Government.

item.title: ICPC To Arraign El-Rufai In Kaduna Today
item.description: The Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission(ICPC) has said that it will arraign former Kaduna State Governor, Nasir El-Rufai, before the Federal High Court in Kaduna over alleged corruption-related offences this tuesday.

item.title: Nigeria Will Pay Heavy Price If Iran War Doesn’t End – Dangote
item.description: We have news that Aliko Dangote, has warned that the Middle-East tensions driving global oil instability could have far-reaching consequences for Nigeria and African economies.

item.title: Colombia Military Says 80 Troops Believed Dead In Plane Crash
item.description: Report says that A military transport plane crashed when taking off in Colombia, with at least 80 people aboard though there were conflicting reports about how many troops were dead and injured.

item.title: Osimhen Undergoes Successful Surgery After Arm Fracture
item.description: Report says that Galatasaray have confirmed that Victor Osimhen has undergone a successful surgery on a fractured right forearm sustained during their 4–0 defeat to Liverpool in the UEFA Champions League Round of 16 second leg

item.title: UK Returnee Dies In Lagos-Ibadan Expressway Crash
item.description: We have news that a woman who had just returned from the United Kingdom to attend a wedding in Abeokuta, Ogun State, has died in a road crash along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway.

item.title: Ondo Police Arrest Two, Recover Stolen Cars
item.description: The Ondo State Police Command has arrested two suspects and recovered a stolen Toyota Camry in Akure, Ondo State.

item.title: El-Rufai Arrives Kaduna Court Under Heavy Security
item.description: Former Kaduna State Governor, Nasir El-Rufai, has arrived at the Federal High Court in Kaduna State, under tight security for his arraignment over alleged corruption-related offences.
